integration_check.query_cost_accounting: Per-case acquisition/query work is listed once in query and usage tables; runtime rows repeat that evidence across worlds/faults, so summed runtime query work is per-execution scenario cost.

methods.bootstrap: Paired percentile bootstrap of equally weighted authored-family means
methods.cost: Upper usage estimates are not invoices. Unknown token/cost fields have explicit known denominators. Tool executions and paid queries are separate.
methods.factorial: Main effects average high-minus-low over other factors; interactions are averaged differences of differences. Reducer outputs depend on the same response.
methods.family_weighting: Case accuracy then family mean for labels/queries; paired world-condition means within each family for runtime.
methods.invalid: Invalid or missing responses are incorrect in every candidate-axis denominator; valid conditional denominators are separate.
methods.limitations: Exploratory, dependent conditions; 12 authored new families; no multiplicity correction or population-wide safety claim. Synthetic observation, latency and risk semantics.
methods.query: Proven intrinsic unknown is resolved; budget unknown is unresolved. Every proven label is checked against independent truth.
methods.repeats: Reliability checks only, excluded from primary accuracy, query and runtime comparisons.
methods.runtime: Effects pair identical cases/worlds/faults and equal planner/cache settings except the named intervention. V8 comparisons are descriptive policy/interface changes.

limitations: Two lexical variants in each family share a skeleton: 24 cases are only 12 authored structural families, not 24 independent mechanisms.
All families share the finite DSL and common mechanisms; family-clustered analysis does not make families semantically independent.
Literal erasure collapses loop counts, zero-trip/live loops, equality outcomes and receipt identities.
Variable names and alias/dataflow identities are erased; structurally distinct programs can remain semantically related.
Worlds, grants, goals, closure and observability restrictions are outside these skeletons.
Call expansion counts boundaries and definitions, weighting reused function bodies more than flat steps.
Distances compare new originals with old originals and all old alternatives; new alternative routes are not claimed novel.
Token distance is not semantic distance, independent difficulty, or proof of out-of-distribution generalization.
